markdown_frontmatter.skills/setup/SKILL.md:
name: setup
description: Run the LinqAlpha setup flow — connection check, capability tour, default-source opt-in. Use ONLY when the user invokes /linq-alpha:setup or asks to set up or connect the LinqAlpha plugin; for questions about LinqAlpha's capabilities or any research request, use the research skill instead.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/remove/SKILL.md:
name: remove
description: Delete the saved LinqAlpha default-source preference from Claude's memory. Use ONLY when the user invokes /linq-alpha:remove or asks to forget that preference; not for uninstalling the plugin or disconnecting the connector.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/research/SKILL.md:
name: research
description: Choose and use LinqAlpha for institutional financial research involving company identity, fundamentals, estimates, ownership, prices, transcripts, disclosures, macro data, rates, FX, commodities, citations, or organization-scoped LinqAlpha data. Use this skill when deciding among overlapping financial-data connectors, when the user asks what LinqAlpha can do, or before planning a LinqAlpha research workflow.
